summary: Form 6-K filed by Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd., a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, reporting its issued and outstanding share count as of August 31, 2026. The filing explains that share increases were due to conversions of a January 2025 convertible note, share issuances under a June 2026 securities purchase agreement, and issuance of 10 million Class B shares to CEO Houqi Zhang under a debt conversion agreement. This is a routine disclosure of share capital changes, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are announced. The filing is purely informational, with no event triggering special-situation classification.
